analogs.note: Strong ocean signal + negative IOD offset → normal monsoon despite Super event.
Closest ocean-heat analog. Moderate drought; coupling locked in fully.
Coupling analog — peaked then faded fast. The cautionary precedent for 2026.
Subsurface heat present but coupling stalled; event underperformed.
Slow developer; weak coupling produced a low-amplitude event.
Big subsurface heat discharged by a June easterly burst; Super deferred to 2015.

analogInference: The analog set splits cleanly into two stories. On the ocean signal — subsurface heat and the Niño 3.4 trajectory — 2026 most resembles 1997 and 2015, the two sustained Super events. On the coupling signal — SOI and trade winds — it resembles 2023, which peaked and faded. The dashboard cannot resolve which story wins; that is precisely what the June–July atmospheric data will decide. The honest read: extraordinary ocean potential, unproven atmospheric follow-through. Weight 1997/2015 if coupling locks in, 2023 if it does not.
